accepted_locus.name: R_1_split

geometric_promotion.branch_identification: the 12 descended (-2)-curves span raw b-perp; adjunction makes the actual -K orthogonal to all twelve, so -K=+/-b, and positivity against the invariant ample class selects +b
geometric_promotion.complex_period: the refined polarized period map applied to the oriented positive plane of the rank-two complement gives NS(X)=L with the prescribed root-regular chamber containing h as the ample cone; tau acts as -1 on the period and fixes h, hence preserves that same chamber, so global Torelli applies without conjugating the split-root data
geometric_promotion.exact_return: the finite-covolume root subgroup forces finite Aut; Kondo's classification and Vinberg2 exhaust all effective irreducible roots, while the one-boundary Halphen cusp bijection exhausts all (-1)-curves; hence the full nef chamber is exactly the raw P
geometric_promotion.fixed_locus: Nikulin (11,11,1) gives exactly one rational fixed curve; the quotient is smooth and rational with irreducible branch B
geometric_promotion.strong_coble_linear_systems: ramification gives R=pi^*(-K_S), pi^*B=2R, hence B~-2K_S and B^2=-4; the irreducible (-2)-curve R has |mR|={mR} for all m>=1.  Pullback would send any D in |-K_S| to R, forcing 2D=B after pushforward, impossible for reduced irreducible B; and any B' in |-2K_S| pulls back to 2R=pi^*B, so B'=B.  Hence |-K_S| is empty and |-2K_S|={B}

enumeration.identity_for_a_minus_two_root: Q_h(x)=2*h^2+2*(h.x)^2; hence the stated bound contains every root of degree zero and every positive root of degree strictly below the largest proposed degree

classification_corollary.positive_content: two independently certified raw inputs acquire primitive rank-20 K3 covers and exact same-P Coble realizations

finite_compiler.exhaustive_branches: all split-root assignments modulo sheet switching, all forced saturations and even tau-stable overclosures, every allowable K3 complement in the finite discriminant-form/genus census, and every discriminant anti-isometry
finite_compiler.implementation_scope: the generic compiler is a mathematical finite algorithm; the live script imports specialized arithmetic split censuses and replays only the two positive rank-20 calibrations, not arbitrary wall matrices
finite_compiler.input: an h-decorated marked wall system in D_1_split
finite_compiler.name: C_1_split
finite_compiler.passing_branch: a primitive equivariant K3 graph glue whose fixed lattice is exactly the primitive marked N(2) with invariants (11,11,1), and whose supplied h passes the complete root-regular and simultaneous bounded irreducibility audit

termination.ample_witness_stage: h is part of the raw oriented datum; strict interior, root regularity, and every irreducibility obstruction are decided by one positive-definite qfminim enumeration per lift branch
termination.closure_and_embedding_stage: anti-rank ten is rejected by the K3 Picard-rank bound; for anti-rank nine, reduced positive even binary complements are finite; for smaller anti-rank, standard finite discriminant-form, genus, and Nikulin primitive-embedding algorithms enumerate the higher-rank complements and equivariant graph glues
termination.split_stage: for each pair of split walls with intersection d, the same/cross pairing has d+1 choices; hence every finite input has a finite product

promotion_theorem.algebraic_geometry_feedback: finite index of the constructed root reflections gives finite Aut; Kondo's classification, root exhaustion, and the Halphen cusp/(-1)-curve bijection then prove exact return
promotion_theorem.essential_surjectivity: not proved on D_1_split: every passing branch constructs a carrier and every exact carrier supplies a passing K3 branch, but no theorem shows that every P in the a priori denominator has a passing branch
promotion_theorem.intrinsic_iff: for every (P,h) in D_1_split: exact same-P one-boundary strong-Coble carrier with h ample exists if and only if C_1_split(P,h) is nonempty
promotion_theorem.ramification_without_frame_hypothesis: the twelve constructed curves span b-perp, so adjunction forces the actual anticanonical half-branch class to be b
promotion_theorem.statement: for every marked h-decorated (P,h) in the independently defined surface-free denominator D_1_split, an exact complex finite-Aut strong one-boundary Coble return carrying h to an ample class exists if and only if C_1_split has a passing branch; every passing branch constructs such a surface and returns the original full nef chamber P

scope.compactness: every member is noncompact because the definition requires primitive isotropic CM cusp rays and their lifted facets; no compact P is covered

contract_audit.AG_pushback_scope: the two-isometry-class classification applies to R_1_split, not to every P in the a priori class D_1_split
contract_audit.branchwise_exact_return: pass: each passing branch constructs a surface whose full nef chamber is the original P
contract_audit.class_wide_realized_branch: not proved: the two positive calibrations and classification of R_1_split do not establish D_1_split=R_1_split
contract_audit.compiler_exhaustivity: pass: the finite compiler enumerates every compatible split-root/K3 carrier branch for each supplied input
contract_audit.intrinsic_iff: pass: on D_1_split, exact carrier existence is equivalent to a passing compiler branch

not_claimed: a theorem for arbitrary arithmetic Coxeter polytopes
a higher-dimensional bound beyond the one-boundary rank-11 class
a replacement for the characteristic-three crystalline compiler
exhaustion or exclusion of algebraic carrier species other than the one-boundary K3/Coble quotient dictionary
scope.rating: uniform non-singleton L3 exact-return criterion and classification of the compiler-positive locus; not strict L4 under the 2026-08-09 strengthened five-part contract
scope.why_not_tautological: D_1_split is defined before and without the carrier compiler; surface existence and exact nef return are equivalent conclusions, while R_1_split is explicitly only the compiler-positive locus

surface_free_denominator.a_priori_scope: the mathematical denominator ranges over all marked wall systems satisfying the displayed arithmetic conditions; the executable artifact below is only a two-input exact calibration
surface_free_denominator.definition: marked finite-volume integral Coxeter wall data, including a specified integral strict interior vector h, in an odd unimodular lattice of signature (1,10), with a unique characteristic norm-minus-one facet b; twelve norm-minus-two facets spanning b-perp and defining a finite-volume root chamber; the root chamber has a nonempty ideal-ray set, all remaining facets equal f-b for exactly those primitive ideal rays f

finite_membership.orientation_stage: integrality and strict interior inequalities for the supplied h
finite_membership.raw_cone_stage: exact Smith, characteristic-vector, reflection, and cddlib double-description calculations

surface_free_denominator.name: D_1_split

absence of every hidden surface curve
equality between the input chamber and a nef cone
